informed_by_prior_failure: Known frozen row0 final-RMS failure motivated prefix coverage. Its3391.698 variance and every old validation outcome are excluded from new domain/coefficient selection. This is not an untouched redesign.

calibration.prompt_source: Exactly the original32topics x3framings=96 prompts; original text bytes remain externally pinned and unopened here.
calibration.construction: From each original S32 token prefix take its exact firstL tokens for L1..32; require exact equality with original S8/S16 entries and original seed mapping before any model reads. No new tokenization of calibration text or choice by activation ranges.
calibration.decode: Same16 original seeds, original native teacher prefixes and actual approximate free prefixes; evaluate native/exact/approximate on each actual shared prefix; preserve stopped suffixes and denominator3200.
calibration.entry_scope: 3200 entries, not3200 unique sequences. Preserve every declared entry and denominator even when prefixes repeat. Tokenizer freeze reports within-calibration and within-validation entry/unique counts by length and never deduplicates.

observation.propagation: Observe every declared nonlinear input, each causalK1..32, every initial/round denominator, and each rational-SiLU tanh base/denominator. Stop before any out-of-domain evaluation; never clip or skip domain checks. Native/exact ranges stay distinct from approximate ranges.

selection.scope: Only all113 normalization rules may change under one policy. All28 SiLU and28 softmax rules, exp8, reciprocal domains/counts and their acceptance gates remain byte-identical to candidate3.
selection.positive_domain: Expanded-calibration union vmin/vmax from native float32 and independent exact float64, all113 sites: base=[max(epsilon,0.8*vmin),1.2*vmax], then[max(epsilon,base_lo/4),base_hi*4]. Same binary64 ordering for every site; no exceptions, label/error fitting, row0 or validation extrema.
selection.failed_candidate_revision: At most3 new-protocol candidates. After a complete failed approximate calibration, union only observed valid-prefix calibration nonlinear inputs with the original native/exact ranges, then reapply the same whole-site rule/ladder. A rejected input may be recorded as an observation without evaluating its invalid operator. Preserve all stopped suffixes; output errors cannot fit coefficients.
selection.coefficient_algorithm: Pinned numeric.coefficients inverse_sqrt interpolation and32*binary64epsilon pruning. Actual stored coefficients and rounded affine map enter the certificate.
selection.uniform_certificate: Exact rational H(t)=((t-B)/A)*P(t)^2-1; endpoint extent M and monotone Chebyshev envelope ||H||1*Tdeg(H)(M). Require delta<1, mapped interval contains0, P(0)>0, and delta/(2-delta)<=1e-6.
selection.binary64_diagnostic: Deduplicated2049 linear +2049 geometric points and actual endpoints, evaluated by unchanged explicit balanced circuit; require finite values and maxrelative<=1e-6. Compare independent Clenshaw diagnostically. These sampled checks do not prove floating/CKKS accuracy.
selection.fallback: Smallest static Newton count <=64 with exact rounded initial-affine residual certificate and same1e-6 relative bound, plus fixed2049 linear/geometric binary64 grids. This must be regenerated from each new public interval; do not reuse old counts for new endpoints. Unsupported certificate/overflow/instability fails the whole candidate.
selection.protected_rule_checks: Observe all protected SiLU/softmax domains in all3200 trajectories and independently recompute conditional public SiLU radii from new norm relative certificates and pinned learned gate/gamma bounds. Any protected-domain/radius failure marks candidate unsupported; no automatic protected-rule retuning.
selection.freeze: Freeze all113 rules/full candidate/provenance before any approximate calibration. Freeze the first fully calibration-passing candidate before any new validation or row0 measurement.

unchanged_numeric_gates.HE_gates: Untested and not inferred; original HE-versus-approximate0.01 nRMSE/0.10 maxabs remain separate.
unchanged_numeric_gates.prefill_top1_aggregation: Aggregate all declared prefixes; report each length separately, no new per-length acceptance gate.
unchanged_numeric_gates.teacher_forced_required_matches: ceil(0.9*decisions);64 calibration requires58;32 new validation requires29

acceptance.failure: Complete coverage and all numeric/semantic/domain gates are mandatory. Count every failed or stopped context in its declared denominator; no partial pass.

design.selection: All32 authored prompts and all prefixes are fixed before any new calibration/validation measurement; no range-based replacement. Tokenizer feasibility/disjointness remains a hard prerequisite, not an achieved fact.
design.raw_text_publication: Public authored fixture design; no private user text or old validation bodies were read.

untouched_validation.prerequisite: Freeze exact new tokenized bodies and hashes BEFORE expanded calibration results/selection. Authorize a tokenizer-only check separately. Require every planned new validation token sequence to differ from the EXPANDED3072 calibration prefix inventory at allL1..32, original teacher/free decode contexts, old calibration/validation/fresh token contexts, and explicit row0 tokenID0 S1. Report exact-sequence intersections and entry/unique counts by length; comparison is by full token sequence, not text or prompt identity; if this fails, preserve the design and freeze a separately reviewed revision before any new model run. Do not silently replace prompts.
untouched_validation.no_feedback: New validation and row0 are opened only after final candidate freeze. Their failures cannot feed another selection using this protocol. Old published/fresh112 are optional regression only, never newly untouched validation.

row0_regression.source: Exact existing checkpoint embedding row0/tokenID0 S1, original position0, same source binding. Generic first-S8 calibration provenance does not establish this row0 fixture.
row0_regression.when: After first complete calibration-passing candidate is frozen; preserve outcome under unchanged operator/logit/domain gates.

process: Root reviews public design and scope. No input/body or model reads authorized by this artifact.
Separate tokenizer-only construction freezes all original prefix mappings and new untouched validation token bodies/disjointness before any expanded results.
Source-freeze native/exact observer and full3200 workload; run only after separate grant; record original416 subset separately.
Perform uniform public selection/certification under this new protocol; freeze complete manifest before approximate3200.
After full calibration pass, evaluate frozen candidate on new1088 validation and row0 regression without selecting a new candidate from their results.

costs.caution: Sequence work is not proportional to entry count. High-degree exact certificates, binary64 stability, inverse-only refresh placement and eventual HE cost must be rederived; prior93 reserve gaps and12931S32 refresh plan do not transfer automatically.
